# TMS4030 - 4096-bit (4K x 1) dynamic RAM, N-channel

Package DIP-22 · family MOS-memory · catalogue file [catalog/chips/TMS4030.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/TMS4030.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 58 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![TMS4030 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/TMS4030.png) | ![TMS4030 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-TMS4030.png) | ![TMS4030 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-TMS4030.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | VBB | power |  |  | -3 V |

| 4 | A11 | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | CS | enable | low |  | controls pins 7; when not enabled: float; chip select, latched at the rising edge of CE; low = this chip takes part in the cycle |
| 6 | DIN | input |  |  |  |

| 14 | A4 | input |  |  |  |
| 15 | A5 | input |  |  |  |
| 16 | NC | nc |  |  |  |
| 17 | CE | clock |  |  | rising edge; chip enable: 12 V (MOS level) clock; the cycle runs while it is high |
| 18 | VDD | power |  |  | +12 V |
| 19 | A6 | input |  |  |  |
| 20 | A7 | input |  |  |  |
| 21 | A8 | input |  |  |  |
| 22 | VSS | ground |  |  |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 7 | Three-state output, inverted from the data written (datasheet: "Data-out is inverted from data-in"). Floats while CE is low. If CS was low at the rise of CE, the output is enabled while CE stays high; it first goes low, then shows the data. If CS was high, the output stays floating. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4096


## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 3.2 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -2 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Recommended: VCC 4.75..5.25 V, VDD 11.4..12.6 V, VBB -2.7..-3.3 V, VSS 0 V. CE high level VDD-0.6..VDD+1 V, other inputs VIH 2.2 V min, VIL 0.6 V max. VOL 0.4 V at 3.2 mA, VOH 2.4 V at -2 mA (two Series 74 loads). |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CE | DOUT | access | 280 | CL 50 pF, tr(CE) 20 ns, 1 Series 74 load |
| A | DOUT | access | 300 | CL 50 pF, tr(CE) 20 ns, 1 Series 74 load |
| CE | DOUT | PZL | 250 | CL 50 pF, 1 Series 74 load (column read as TMS4030 max) |

## Not known

- Output disable time tPHZ/tPLZ (30 ns) appears in the text layer under a MIN column heading; not recorded because min vs max is unclear.
- tPZL value (250 ns for the base grade) read from a jumbled text layer.
- The datasheet is marked "PRELIMINARY DATA SHEET".
- Edge reference arrows in the timing tables were lost in the text layer; rising/falling CE references above follow the readable notes and waveform titles and should be checked against the page image.
- CS must be held high as long as CE is high in a cycle where the chip is not selected (page 2); what happens if CS falls during such a cycle is not stated. The model uses CS as latched at the rise of CE.

## Notes

ND manual title "4 K MOS RAM". Same 22-pin pinout as Intel 2107B, but VBB is -3 V here.

## Sources

- [Texas Instruments TMS 4030 JL, NL; TMS 4030-1; TMS 4030-2 4096-bit dynamic RAMs, bulletin DL-S 7512240, Feb 1975 (preliminary)](https://www.tvsat.com.pl/pdf/t/tms4030_ti.pdf) - 1-6 (printed 41-46); TMS 4030 (300 ns grade)
